shortDescription: Apollo Global Management NYSE:APO is in discussions to acquire Johnson & Johnson's NYSE:JNJ orthopedics unit in a deal that could value the unit at close to $20 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing sources.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
